name: Shadow Eyes
summary: The protagonist takes on the role of an Urban Explorer, where this time, he decides to explore a forest called 'Raven Wood', where there is a legend that says there is a creature that is not human, but has a similar form, that kills anyone who dares to enter it. According to reports, these creatures emerged through a ritual, and according to rumors, all those who dared to enter the forest never came out, except for one person who managed to survive after entering this place, and mysteriously was killed 2 weeks after visiting the place.
